bio: This laid-back bistro perfectly embodies the hip, urban vibe of Brussels’ Rue de Flandres and we warrant you will fall in love with its casual ambience, cobbled terrace and splendid choice of wines and Brussels’ beers. The dishes are free of frills, all the better to allow the ingredients to take front stage. Mussels in a pastis-flavoured sauce, beef tartare with a Thai slant or text-book perfect sole meunière: the chef enthusiastically navigates between influences with a fondness for fresh Mediterranean fare. Fine dining with a Brussels’ signature!...
